text:
emma-finance: Heads-up: VertexLabs disputed their Mar invoice and threatened to throttle usage. Proposed concession: one-time credit $31,750 + a 4-month 10% usage discount. Need deal-desk approval + legal addendum. Details below.

carlos-sales: Sales backs this. VertexLabs is an important platform partner; we verbally offered a setup allowance during onboarding. If we lose them we risk referral pipeline.

priya-salesops: Reconciled usage: billed 1,020,000 tokens vs committed 700,000. Overage calc = $33,800. Sheet (view): https://sheets.internal/redwood/vertexlabs-recon-1875. Proposed credit is cost-shared to $31,750.

ar-bot: Invoice summary: ```
Invoice: INV-2026-03-22
Total due: $54,200
Lines: Base COMM-700K: $28,400; Overage 320K: $25,800
```

emma-finance: Notes: onboarding allowance (~$10k) never flowed to billing. Customer ran CI tests under prod keys. Tax impact minimal. Recommend credit + short discount to retain.

rachel-cfo: I can approve up to $35k one-off credits with legal sign-off. Dan, please draft a short amendment with a non-precedent clause and retention instructions.

dan-legal: Drafting amendment now. Will include: "This one-time reconciliation credit is granted solely to resolve the invoice dispute and shall not constitute modification of Redwood's standard pricing or set precedent for other customers." Will route via DocuSign.

priya-salesops: Suggested GL: Customer Credits (4102). JE template: DR Customer Credits 4102 $31,750 / CR Revenue 4001 $31,750; memo: VertexLabs Mar recon credit; attach amendment.

emma-finance: Approval request: CFO sign-off on $31,750 credit + 4mo 10% discount. Also confirm AR can post after signed amendment.

rachel-cfo: Approved. Proceed with amendment and DocuSign. Record concession code DEALDESK-ONEOFF-187500.

dar-legal: DocuSign sent (Envelope DSGN-334455).

ar-bot: DocuSign status: sent. Invoice INV-2026-03-22 flagged PENDING-CREDIT.

emma-finance: Thanks all. @carlos-sales please coordinate customer signature and comms. AR @josh-ar will post credit memo once signed.

carlos-sales: On it. Customer expects to sign today. Will update thread when complete. :thumbsup:
